combine.rule: A component joins the combined model of a method if its validation flooded-mIoU change (seed-matched, against the frozen baseline) has a positive mean at both budgets and is positive for at least 2 of 3 seeds at each budget. U-Net components: aux10, recipe, tta, res512, encoder (decided on the U-Net). RF components: aux10, res512, rf_context (decided on the RF). The combined hybrid refines the combined U-Net.

hybrid.after: the improved U-Net of the same budget and seed
hybrid.before: the original U-Net of the same budget and seed

hybrid.after: the same setting, pixel widths doubled for the 512 px input (no new tuning)

rf.after: SLIC, 250 superpixels per image (about 1,048 px each)
rf.before: SLIC, 250 superpixels per image (about 262 px each)

rf.after: 50 per region: the original 22, the mean of those 22 over its touching neighbours, its centroid (y, x), its area share and the mean colour of the coarse SLIC region (60 segments) it lies in
rf.before: 22 per region: RGB and HSV mean and standard deviation, 10-bin LBP texture histogram

rf.after: 10 original FloodNet classes (region majority); predictions mapped back to the 3 classes
rf.before: 3 classes (region majority): Other, flooded building, flooded road

rf.after: 512 px prediction area-averaged onto the same 256 px test grid

unet.after: up to 60 epochs, stop after 12 without improvement
unet.before: up to 30 epochs, stop after 6 without improvement

unet.after: running average of the weights (EMA, decay 0.999), best validation epoch
unet.before: the trained weights at the best validation epoch

unet.after: mean of 8 predictions: the image flipped and rotated, each mapped back (test-time augmentation)
512 px prediction area-averaged onto the same 256 px test grid
